build_dataset_voxforge: build a tfds BeamBasedBuilder dataset for VoxForge audio language classification with train, validation, and test splits
create_split_boundaries: create split boundaries from probability weights and item count for dataset train/validation/test partitioning
build_pcollection_examples: build a Beam Pcollection of audio examples from VoxForge tar archives with label, speaker_id, and waveform samples
generate_audio_examples: generate labeled audio examples from VoxForge archives yielding key-value pairs with audio samples, language labels, and speaker IDs
split_by_speaker_groups: split dataset items into train/validation/test groups ensuring all samples from each speaker stay in the same split
